nombre_oficial.texto: The boulders at the base of the hill

frase_gancho.texto: Reliefs with mythic and ritual themes, carved on great boulders.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: At the foot of the hill, on great boulders, there are reliefs with mythic and ritual themes: supernatural animals dominating people and a procession of masked figures. They stand several meters apart and cannot be seen together: you have to walk from one to the next.
